fields.label: Purchase Order
fields.description: The authorization this delivery is checked against — resolved by PO number or supplier lookup, not picked by hand.

fields.label: Vehicle No
fields.description: Captured fresh at the gate — a Purchase Order carries no vehicle info of its own, so there's nothing to snapshot from the source here.

fields.label: Items Summary
fields.description: Item, pending quantity and UOM per line on the Purchase Order at the moment of verification — snapshot, not live.

fields.label: PO Status At Verification
fields.description: The Purchase Order's own status at the moment it was checked — e.g. 'To Receive'. Snapshot, not live.

fields.label: Supplier Was Active At Verification
fields.description: Supplier.disabled was 0 at the moment of this check — the real 'active supplier' gate, independent of whether they're also flagged a contractor.

fields.label: Gate Departure Time
fields.description: When the truck leaves after dropping off goods — confirmed separately from arrival, since offloading takes time.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.description: Required context when Gate Verification Status is Rejected — why entry was refused (no PO found, wrong vehicle/driver, supplier not active). This is an identity/paperwork check, not a cargo inspection — content verification is the stock team's job at receiving.
